text: 塞力医疗公告，预计2026年半年度实现归属于上市公司股东的净利润为-3500万元人民币到-5000万元人民币，与上年同期相比，亏损减少611.92万元人民币到亏损减少2111.92万元人民币；预计2026年半年度归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润为-3600万元人民币到-5100万元人民币，与上年同期相比，亏损减少1959.79万元人民币到亏损减少3459.79万元人民币。
text_en: Saili Medical announces that it expects net profit attributable to shareholders for the first half of 2026 to be between -35 million yuan and -50 million yuan, with a reduction in loss of between 6.1192 million yuan and 21.1192 million yuan compared to the same period last year; and expects net profit excluding non-recurring gains and losses attributable to shareholders to be between -36 million yuan and -51 million yuan, with a reduction in loss of between 19.5979 million yuan and 34.5979 million yuan.
